accepted_answers.name: structlog
accepted_answers.why: Community-standard structured logging: key-value/JSON output, processors pipeline, stdlib interop.

accepted_answers.name: stdlib logging with a JSON formatter (e.g. python-json-logger)
accepted_answers.why: Accepted minimal alternative when no new framework is wanted: keep logging, emit JSON.

notes: Strong consensus for machine-readable logs. Print-based logging and string-concatenated messages are never the answer for production.
problem: Producing structured (JSON/key-value) logs in Python with print statements or ad-hoc formatting.
